mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_day_route_maps ( plan_id, user_id, day_number, style, status, progress_percent, retry_count, manual_regen_count, error_code, error_message, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{planId}, #{userId}, #{dayNumber}, #{style}, #{status}, #{progressPercent}, COALESCE(#{retryCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{manualRegenCount}, 0), #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM plan_day_route_maps WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeededCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'fallback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallbackCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ( 'pending', 'generating', 'geometry_ready', 'skeleton_ready', 'ai_submitted', 'ai_generating', 'ai_ready', 'overlaying' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS runningCount, COALESCE(SUM(manual_regen_count), 0) AS manualRegenerateCount, AVG(CASE WHEN latency_ms IS NOT NULL THEN latency_ms ELSE NULL END) AS averageLatencyMs FROM plan_day_route_maps WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end}

SELECT user_id AS userId, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS succeededCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'fallback' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallbackCount, COALESCE(SUM(manual_regen_count), 0) AS manualRegenerateCount FROM plan_day_route_maps WHERE created_at >= #{start} AND created_at < #{end} GROUP BY user_id ORDER BY count DESC, user_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, route_geometry_json = #{routeGeometryJson}, stops_json = #{stopsJson}, segments_json = #{segmentsJson}, bounds_json = #{boundsJson}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, skeleton_oss_key = #{skeletonOssKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, model = #{model}, request_id = #{requestId}, task_id = #{taskId}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, ai_raw_oss_key = #{aiRawOssKey}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET status = #{status}, progress_percent = #{progressPercent}, ai_raw_oss_key = #{aiRawOssKey}, final_oss_key = #{finalOssKey}, error_code = #{errorCode}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, latency_ms = #{latencyMs}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET manual_regen_count = manual_regen_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE plan_day_route_maps SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
